clientScopes.description: CIP optional scope (audit read): Read the token tenant's audit trail. Read-only and separate from tenant and connector administration. Per-token, role-gated, tenant-bound; never a default.

clientScopes.description: CIP optional scope (tenant administration): Administer the token tenant's own CIP settings, projects and member role requests. Never cross-tenant, never realm or platform administration. Per-token, role-gated, tenant-bound; never a default.
